items.title: Gaza mourns four killed in Israeli strike

items.title: Trump declares US-Iran peace deal 'now complete,' as Iran confirms 'immediate end' to the war
items.description: 'The deal with the Islamic Republic of Iran is now complete,' US President Donald Trump announced on Sunday. Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif posted on X that a peace deal 'has been reached,' and Iran confirmed the agreement shortly after.

items.title: IDF says it killed key Hezbollah official responsible for deadly 2007 attack on US troops
items.description: Ali Mussa Daqduq was reported in 2024 to have been killed by Israel in Syria, but he apparently survived; military says he was targeted in strike on south Lebanon over the weekend The post IDF says it killed key Hezbollah official responsible for deadly 2007 attack on US troops appeared first on The Times of Israel.

items.description: Russia and Ukraine continued to exchange air attacks on June 14, as indefinitely paused peace talks between Moscow and Kyiv appear to be overshadowed by developments on the battlefield.

items.title: Refugee turned peacemaker: The young woman leader transforming communities in the Central African Republic
items.description: In the heart of the Central African Republic (CAR), a nation long marked by conflict, Nina Mireille Yankinon stands as a symbol of resilience, leadership, and hope, dedicating her life to helping communities torn apart by war.

items.title: Britain detains sanctioned oil tanker believed to be linked to Russia's shadow fleet
